weatherRules.directEvidence: Ricacci autunnali in condizioni piovose e dopo sfalcio
weatherRules.implementation: Autumn branch if regrowth observed or mowing known plus water context; rainfall alone possible-to-check
Observed young leaves valid outside spring locally; mowing cannot be inferred from rain

weatherRules.directEvidence: Genotype×site-specific drought response, sometimes lower production, sometimes higher
weatherRules.implementation: Drought contextual flag; no universal rain/soil multiplier
Potential stress context, no leaf-harvest GDD or soil threshold

weatherRules.directEvidence: Drought experiment vegetative only; frost changes quality but does not prove abundance
weatherRules.implementation: No direct weather bonus to ripe-fruit score

weatherRules.directEvidence: CH=sum(hours 0<T<7°C) from Nov1; GDD=sum(max(0,Tmean−8°C)) from observed budbreak; observed29–46GDD
weatherRules.implementation: Candidate auxiliary spring-flowering model only; not used for autumn ripe-fruit score

weatherRules.directEvidence: Leaf-out frost exposure depends on ecotype/phase
weatherRules.implementation: Tmin<0 flags modeled freezing-air event; not tissue damage percentage; universal0.4penalty unsupported

decisionConstraints: Edibility, identification and preparation independent from weather and score.
Flowering calendar cannot stand for ripe fruit or young leaf calendar.
Unknown component omitted with explicit coverage; missing/expired weather must not suppress habitat+food-calendar recommendation.
Zone-level private unreviewed note is limited context, not presence at another trail/elevation/patch.
Availability none is non-detection/remaining quantity, not biological absence of species.
Unknown elevation stays null. No invented meter threshold from botanical altitudinal belts.
Outside described elevation/calendar not proven impossible.
Ordinal mappings, weights, smoothing, source-domain transfer are versioned implementation hypotheses.
No harvest probabilities or scientific attribution of invented coefficients.
